productionReview: Keep incoming projector and breadth-first seed optimizations. Correct independently verified arbitrary-string graph-key loss with own-safe dictionaries/lookups, preserving ordinary coordinates and existing return shape. Registry-icons React.lazy generic is typing only. No new production hooks.
validation: Two focused rows+graph controls passed 66/66, zero failures/cancellations/skips. The new graph case first failed the unchanged implementation for the intended missing __proto__ own key. Both graph-revert and omitted-rollback-context mutants failed intended direct assertions; source hashes restored exactly in finally. Graph benchmark confirmed exact ordinary chain/star/disconnected positions/order against ee5. Public object prototype/own-key probe passed. Scoped syntax/diff checks passed. No full-package/typecheck gates run by this child; root coordinates those.
